Explore my work with microcontrollers, FPGAs, and embedded systems.
These labs cover digital logic, hardware interfaces, and the design
and testing of integrated hardware and software systems.

### Lab 4: Digital Audio

Generating musical notes with STM32 hardware timers,

through an audio amplifier.

Using interrupts to read a quadrature encoder and

### Lab 6: Internet of Things

Connecting a temperature sensor over SPI and an ESP8266
over UART to display temperature readings and control
an LED through a webpage.

[View Lab 6](../labs/lab%206/lab6.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

### Lab 7: AES Encryption

Implementing AES-128 encryption on an FPGA, with a
microcontroller sending plaintext and a key over SPI
and receiving the encrypted result.

[View Lab 7](../labs/lab%207/lab7.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
